Definition

A smart contract-based reserve of tokens supplied by users to facilitate decentralized trading, lending, or yield generation, providing essential market liquidity in DeFi platforms.

Operational example

Liquidity pools enable automated market makers to facilitate decentralized trading without order books, allowing portfolio managers to earn fees by providing assets.
